description: Return the top surf spots in SurfBooking zones right now, ranked by current live conditions. Scores every active SurfBooking spot (wave height, swell period, wind, coast facing) and returns the best ones with wave height, wind, surf score, level suitability, and a link to each beach's page with its lessons. Great for 'what's the best surf spot today?', 'onde está o surf melhor agora?', or 'melhores condições de surf em Portugal'. Conditions are cached from the live forecast and updated every 15 minutes. Read-only, SurfBooking zones only: Portugal (27 zones), South Africa (4 zones), Spain (2 zones), Italy (2 zones). The ranking is by live conditions only, not weighted to one surfer level.

level.description: Optional — filter to spots suitable for this level.

limit.description: Number of spots to return (default 8, max 20).

name: best_surf_today
